text:
Owen Martinez: Hey @people-ops, quick heads-up. Priya asked to be removed from morning on-call for two weeks due to a medical procedure. She suggested switching to afternoons only. I'm worried about coverage and also noticed a small dip in a couple of deliverables this sprint. What's the right process?
Priya Desai: Hi Owen 1 thanks for flagging. I have a procedure on 2026-05-05 and need morning recovery for two weeks after. I can cover afternoons and do async handoffs. I've already uploaded a clinic note to the secure HR link.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Thanks both. This is the ADA interactive process; please use the confidential upload (ticket HR-12011). People Ops will coordinate manager ack and temporary coverage. Priya, thanks for proactively providing the note.
oncall-bot: On-call swap request created: OC-4420. Please confirm swap pairing in the thread.
Owen Martinez: I can cover Priya's Tue/Wed mornings for the two-week window and will update the rota. Can you confirm which exact dates?
Priya Desai: Dates: 2026-05-06 through 2026-05-19 (inclusive). I will update my calendar and add detailed handoff notes to the runbook.
Marta Chen (HR): For transparency 1 we'll keep medical details confidential. Manager (Owen) needs to document temporary coverage plan and whether any performance concerns are related to this accommodation or separate. If there's a performance gap, let's handle that outside the accommodation conversation to avoid conflating medical needs with performance management.
Owen Martinez: Understood. My note: small delay on the telemetry task last sprint was due to unexpected bugs; not related to Priya's availability. I'll add that to the project notes. Priya, thanks for the runbook handoffs 1 that helps.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Next steps: 1) People Ops posts draft accommodation agreement to HR-12011 (private) 2) Owen signs manager acknowledgement 3) On-call swaps are confirmed (OC-4420) 4) Review after 2 weeks. We'll also schedule a non-evaluative 15m check-in mid-window.
Priya Desai: Sounds good. Appreciate the quick coordination.
Owen Martinez: I'll sign the manager ack once it's posted and finalize the rota.
Aisha Kaur (People Ops): Agreement posted to HR-12011. Please sign within 48h. Reminder: medical docs remain private.
Priya Desai: Signed the form. Thank you.
oncall-bot: Reminder: OC-4420 on-call swap pending confirmation: Owen -> Priya (mornings).
Owen Martinez: Confirmed and rota updated. Good luck with the procedure Priya.
Priya Desai: Thanks all 1 really appreciate it.
